lensXraySay: Ilensi ye-X-ray. Khomba noma yini ukuze ubone ukuthi yenziwe kanjani.
lensMakersSay: Ilensi yabenzi. Khomba noma yini ukuze ubone ukuthi ubani oyenzile.
lensFlagSay: Ilensi yefulegi. Khetha ingxenye ofuna ukuyibika noma ofisa ngayo okuthile.
lensesOffSay: Amalensi avaliwe. Isistimu isebenza njengenjwayelo; imiphetho ibonisa ukuthi izibuko zisagqokiwe.
followingSay: Kulandelwa u-{name}: konke akwenzile kudwetshelwe umugqa. Chofoza noma iyiphi ingxenye ukuze ubone ukuthi ubani omunye oyenzile.
putOnSay: Ubona lokho okubonwa yi-Future Traveler. Khomba noma yini ukuze ubone ukuthi yenziwe kanjani.
holdingSay: Kumile ku-{tag}. Cindezela u-Escape ukuze uyiyeke.
ownerOutside: Akuveli ku-HAX; ukuthi ubani oyenzile akwaziwa lapha
nothingOnScreen: Akukho abakwenzile okukulesi sikrini njengamanje. Vula isihleli noma elinye ikhasi bese izingxenye zabo zikhanya.
shotFailedSay: Isithombe-skrini asikwazanga ukwenziwa lapha, ngakho inkinga iphethe isifinyezo se-X-ray esikhundleni saso.
shotReadySay: Isithombe-skrini silungile. Siya ebhodini lakho lokunamathisela uma uvula inkinga, ukuze ukwazi ukusinamathisela.
shotBlockedSay: Isiphequluli sakho sivimbe ukukopisha isithombe. Chofoza kwesokudla isithombe-skrini bese ukhetha u-Copy image, bese usinamathisela enkingeni.
shotCopiedSay: Isithombe-skrini sikopishiwe. Enkingeni, chofoza lapho kuthi namathisela khona, bese ucindezela u-Ctrl+V (Cmd+V ku-Mac).
copyBlockedSay: Ukukopisha kuvinjelwe isiphequluli. Khetha umbhalo esikhundleni salokho.
flaggedSay: I-{tag} ifakwe ifulegi. Chaza okubonile noma ofisa ukuthi ikwenze.
notRegistered: Le ngxenye ayikho kurejista ye-HAX, ngakho umlando wayo awaziwa lapha.
agentCommits: Ama-commit angu-{commits} engeziwe enziwe ngama-ejenti okubhala ikhodi, aqondiswa abantu abangenhla.
shotFailedCaption: Isifinyezo se-X-ray, {w} x {h} px. Isithombe-skrini asikwazanga ukwenziwa lapha.
shotCaption: I-PNG engu-{w} x {h} px, {kb} KB. Uma ukukopisha kuvinjelwe, chofoza kwesokudla isithombe bese ukhetha u-Copy image.
lensTranslateSay: Ilensi yokuhumusha. Yonke ingxenye yombhalo enomugqa ozungezile ingathuthukiswa. Thepha eyodwa.
txPickLangHint: I-HAX ishintshela kulo, ukuze ubone amagama abantu abawabona ngempela. Ungalushintsha noma nini.
txLinkCopied: Isixhumanisi sikopishiwe. Noma ubani osivulayo uthola leli khasi nge-{lang} kuvulwe ilensi yokuhumusha.
txKeep: Gcina {tokens} njengoba kubhaliwe ncamashi: i-HAX ifaka inani lapho.
txEmpty: Akukabikho lutho. Thepha noma yimaphi amagama anomugqa ozungezile ukuze uqale.
txSendHint: Kuvula umbiko osulungisiwe. Ngena ku-GitHub bese ucindezela u-Create. Awudingi ukushintsha lutho kuwo.
txCopied: Kukopishiwe. Kunamathisele ku-imeyili noma engxoxweni uthumele ethimbeni le-HAX.
txLookingAt: {en}, manje {now}. Cindezela u-Enter ukuze uphakamise amagama angcono.
noChecksFound: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo akutholanga lutho lapha. Chaza okubekuvimbela.
alreadyReported: Sekubikiwe? Bheka kuqala, bese unikeza u-+1 lapho esikhundleni salokho.
replayHelp: Ukuphinda-dlala kuvumela umnakekeli ukuthi avule lokhu kusayithi yokuhlola abone inkinga. Amafayela avela kusayithi yakho ashintshwa ngezimeli-ndawo.
replayTooBig: Lokhu kuphinda-dlala kukhulu kakhulu kulesi sixhumanisi. Kulande bese uhudula ifayela ulifake enkingeni.
githubAccount: Imibiko iya ku-GitHub; udinga i-akhawunti ye-GitHub.
